title: Made a game that will teach you how to achieve financial freedom
author: EasternEuropeMate
selftext:
I am making a free to play pixel art game. Live a whole life, work, learn and invest until your passive income pays all your costs. Financial freedom before 65. Stay healthy and happy too.

The idea is to teach basic money rules and personal finance topics in a simple playful way.  
Since it is a work in progress, I am happy to get any feedback, ideas, or bugs you catch.

My main goal now is to improve the visual quality of the pixel art, but it turned to be more difficult than I expected. Would like to connect with someone who could help me better understand the workflow around AI pixel art.

Have a long backlog of new things to add, but would like to collect more real life data and hear from others what they like & dislike in the game.
